title: Walking towards the school building
body: Riya, a student whose eyes are 1.5 m above the ground, stands on level ground some distance away from her school building, which is 31.5 m tall. Looking at the top edge of the building, she measures the angle of elevation of the top from her eyes as 30°. She then walks straight towards the building along a line that passes through its foot. At a second position the angle of elevation of the top of the building from her eyes is 60°. Assume the ground is horizontal and the building is vertical.
